examples.name: permutations

props.name: FileTokenGroupProps
rows: Show file size in the token. Use `i18nStrings.formatFileSize` to customize it.
Show file last modified timestamp in the token. Use `i18nStrings.formatFileLastModified` to customize it.
Show file thumbnail in the token. Only supported for images.
Called when the user clicks on the dismiss button. The token won't be automatically removed. Make sure that you add a listener to this event to update your application state.
Specifies the maximum number of displayed tokens. If the property isn't set, all of the tokens are displayed.
Specifies the direction in which tokens are aligned (`horizontal | vertical`).

An array of objects representing token items. Each token has the following properties: - `file` (string) - File value. - `loading` (boolean) - (Optional) Determine whether the token is loading. - `errorText` (string) - (Optional) Text that displays as a validation error message. - `warningText` (string) - (Optional) - Text that displays as a validation warning message.
Adds an `aria-label` to the "Show fewer" button. Use to assign unique labels when there are multiple file token groups with the same `limitShowFewer` label on one page.
Adds an `aria-label` to the "Show more" button. Use to assign unique labels when there are multiple file token groups with the same `limitShowMore` label on one page.
Specifies if the control is read-only, which prevents the user from modifying the value. A read-only control is still focusable.

An object containing all the localized strings required by the component: * `removeFileAriaLabel` (function): A function to render the ARIA label for file token remove button. Receives file index and file name. * `errorIconAriaLabel` (string): The ARIA label to be shown on the error file icon. * `warningIconAriaLabel` (string): The ARIA label to be shown on the warning file icon. * `formatFileSize` (function): (Optional) A function that takes file size in bytes, and produces a formatted string. * `formatFileLastModified` (function): (Optional) A function that takes the files last modified date, and produces a formatted string.
